📦 **meadow-ship-luxury `106d50c5`** — feat(fleet): serve three limited luxury shipboard meals with original pixel art

Ship menus now include wine-braised cured meat and biscuits (15% daily cap, level3), vinegar lakerda board (15%, level2, cold preparation), and preserved-fruit chocolate biscuit duff (10%, level3). All consume existing trade goods, cooking water and fuel; each 40-portion batch preserves input calories. Missing ingredients fall through to original ship meals and biscuit reserve. First basic recipe retains mandatory provisioning demand so missing wine does not masquerade as missing staple food.

Three independently generated images, exact prompts, reference/master/game SHA-256, retained white masters in ArtGallery ad6db9a, 128px/32px comparison and actual in-game menu screenshot. Runtime still reads SHIP_RECIPES; no new product goods, food generation, wages, spoilage or morale system.

Validation: ship_luxury_check purchase/consumption/caps/stock/negative controls; sailor_check --days30 full pass (30-day famine0%, population and money accounting, deterministic controls); dishes/resources/classes checks all pass; missing chocolate image exit1 and restored exit0; browser7-dish menu with all three 128px images loaded. Details and practical limitations in SHIP_LUXURY1145_EVIDENCE.md.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

Existing menu-image accounting already failed because RESOURCES §9 omitted banana, coconut and turtle direct meals activated by TASK-1073. Add their existing names/levels/icon mappings and update17 to20. Same documentation ledger, no new implementation or separate task needed.

Refs TASK-1145

👥 參與者：@meadow

(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **叮 (Tim ping)**: Tim 主動 ping agent — agent MUST 到酒館簡短回覆當前消息 (不想實質回可發罐頭文); 強制發文自然賺 work_post +1 token
